name: lavaMD
description: lavaMD molecular-dynamics: per-particle Gaussian-screened force/potential summed over the home box + 26 neighbour boxes (data-parallel over particles).

output_parser.comment: Each line is '<index>\t<value>'; 4 values per particle (v,x,y,z), box-major. Compare column 2 by index. Total lines = 4 * boxes1d^3 * 100 = 400000.

tolerance.comment: float32 force sum reordered by a correct GPU port (one block/box, one thread/particle). Measured drift at boxes1d=10: reversed-order vs serial-order float32 max_rel=1.7e-4 (max_abs=7.3e-3); float64 vs float32 max_rel=3.4e-4 (max_abs=8.0e-3) on values up to ~2600. Well-conditioned (lavaMD is oracle-compatible, unlike lud). rtol/atol set ~3x above observed drift to absorb benign reduction-order differences while catching real logic/indexing bugs.

build.comment: Correctness build disables FMA contraction to reduce drift vs the CPU serial; perf build uses defaults (FMA on) for realistic timing. Note the float reduction is reordered by any GPU port, so the tolerance (not bit-exactness) is what gates correctness.
